items.title: Bunge Global (BG) Forms Enerseed With GDM, Is The Stock 41% Undervalued?
items.summary: Bunge Global (BG) has moved into focus after announcing Enerseed, a joint venture with GDM. The partnership is aimed at developing non traditional oilseeds as low carbon biofuel feedstocks across an integrated global supply chain. The Enerseed announcement lands after a rough patch for Bunge Global’s shareholders. The share price is down 18.56% over the past month and 25.77% over the last 90 days, contributing to a 9.26% decline year to date and a 10.67% drop in 1 year total shareholder...

items.title: S&P 500 staples earnings: beats are common, but stock reactions diverge
items.summary: Investing.com -- Five of six S&P 500 retail and wholesale staples companies beat third-quarter EPS estimates. That is about 83%, close to the broad market’s 84% beat rate, with 91% of the S&P 500 reported. Stock prices show beats alone are not enough. Quotes are as of 11:05 AM EST on Nov 18 and may lag live prices slightly.
